quotes.text: Change, notifications, let your app react instantly to events in Microsoft 365 without constant checking.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: The simplest definition of what change notifications are for.

quotes.text: It's a security check. It proves your endpoint is alive, listening, and under your control. It stops someone from pointing a subscription at a URL they don't own, hoping to intercept notifications meant for someone else.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains the purpose behind the validation handshake rather than just the mechanics.

quotes.text: Check the expiration timestamp on every notification you receive. If it's close to expires, say within a day, renew it right then. That way you don't need a separate background job just to manage subscriptions.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A practical renewal best practice that simplifies subscription management.

quotes.text: Change notifications are the fire alarm. They tell you something is happening right now. Delta queries are the sprinkler system. They catch anything the alarm missed.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable analogy for combining push notifications with delta queries.

quotes.text: That doesn't mean you have to process every notification in under three seconds. Just acknowledge receipt quickly with a 202 accepted response. Then process the notification asynchronously, queue it up, handle it later.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concrete guidance on keeping webhook endpoints fast and reliable.

takeaways: Microsoft Graph change notifications push events to your app through subscriptions, replacing wasteful polling that risks throttling.
Every subscription needs a validation handshake within 10 seconds and must be renewed before its resource-specific expiration.
Acknowledge notifications fast, use delta queries as a safety net, and choose webhooks, Event Hubs or Event Grid based on volume.
hook: Polling Microsoft Graph every few minutes wastes requests, misses changes and can get your app throttled. This episode explains for Microsoft 365 developers how change notifications, subscriptions, validation and renewal work, and how to build reliable real-time apps with delta queries as a safety net.
